Harbour upstream notice reference, not an hbide license declaration

Source repository observed: https://github.com/harbour/core.git
Source commit: 694428e1c12f726675b19324d62167fa77d68185
Upstream path: LICENSE.txt
Exact copy: LICENSE.upstream.txt
SHA256: a9fe6deb24f0d29dfee442b6b6864d0ca30e7fefdffce331a0c1522d4b2c3095

This file records the upstream text only. It does not select a license for
hbide's own code or modifications, grant rights from their holders, or clear
redistribution of any source or binary package. The upstream text contains
separate compiler and library sections and other notices; it must not be
presented as a blanket license for this repository.

Fourteen vendored hbdebug sources refer to LICENSE.txt. That root reference
remains missing. All fourteen first comment notices match the identified
upstream files exactly. Four complete files are byte-identical; ten differ
outside those notices. Those differences are not reviewed for ownership or
licensing here. See docs/evidence/harbour-notice-provenance-q353.json for
per-file hashes, paths, exact comparisons and committed-upstream checks.

Open decisions: holders' terms for original code and modifications, correct
scope and location of required notices, dependency and package review.
No redistribution clearance follows from this reference copy.
